text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The battle between Air Groove and Silence
Suzuka is over! Air Groove
pulled off an intense burst of speed in
the last moments and edged Silence
Suzuka out for the victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gasp...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Did I... really win?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I'm seeing afterimages of Suzuka even
now! I... I
can't stop shaking!)

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing, Suzuka! Don't sweat
it!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Suzuka! You were so fabulous out there!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The audience is entranced by Suzuka's 
performance... I'm not the only one who
can't
shake the image of her from my
mind.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That's just how beautiful, unbound,
and...
dazzling Suzuka is on the track.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I understand that more than anyone
else.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I lost today. I couldn't keep up with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I may have won the race, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Inside, in my heart... You floored me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop shaking.
This isn't the thrill
of winning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's... awe. And longing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I... didn't surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I... Sorry. Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove may have beaten Silence
Suzuka, but
the look on her face
suggests inner torment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You see it too, don't you? I couldn't
surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won the race, but the image of her
running is
burned into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't stop shaking even now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's frustration is apparent. I
desperately
try to think of something to
say...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Please... Don't make that face.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've still got training tomorrow. Slow
and
steady, just as always.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, the race we need to
aim for is
the Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that should do, shouldn't it?
There's
nothing you need to worry about
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading back ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen Air Groove look so upset
before...
